theorems.name: Submission.rectifiable_of_approx_tangent_measure
theorems.statement: ∀ (n ℓ : ℕ) (μ : Measure (Rn (n + ℓ))), (∀ K : Set (Rn (n + ℓ)), IsCompact K → μ K < ∞) → (∀ᵐ x ∂μ, ∃ (P : Submodule ℝ (Rn (n + ℓ))) (θ : ℝ), 0 < θ ∧ HasApproxTangentPlaneWithMultiplicity n μ x P θ) → ∃ R : Set (Rn (n + ℓ)), MeasurableSet R ∧ CountablyRectifiable n R ∧ μ Rᶜ = 0
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
